interface.shortDescription: Tenders, AI CPV finder and daily email alerts.
interface.longDescription: Search public tenders across Europe and North America, compare deadlines and budgets, and build a shortlist. Describe your activity to find official EU CPV codes in your assistant. Without an account, tender search and CPV discovery share 2 query per rolling hour per IP. Connected Scoutee accounts, including Free, share 50 calls per account per day across clients and workspaces. Review suggested codes with your assistant, then use them with workspace search or browse the official catalogue. Register free for 1 daily email alert(s) on Scoutee, with up to 20 results per search.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the CPV codes for my business with Scoutee.
